basis: WOX5/QHB-clade homeobox TF; Molecular Cartography signal in QC but stronger in metaxylem (Fig 2F), scRNA cl2 (QC/Niche) and cl10; hvwox5 CRISPR mutant has more QC divisions and fewer columella stem-cell layers (Fig 5) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Lowered from the review's high because the in situ signal is not QC-specific and cl2 also holds niche/initials; use with tip position. Named HvWOX9 in Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants (same ID).

Strongest Molecular Cartography signal in the central metaxylem file (Fig 2F), like rice QHB; hvwox5 mutant has doubled/divided metaxylem (Fig 5H-K); scRNA cl10 (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Also in QC, so not exclusive. Single study.

GRAS TF (UniProt A0A8I6WIH0, 449 aa, 'Scarecrow-like protein 23'; AtSCL23 acts with SCR/SHR in endodermis); HCR in endodermis and a few QC cells (Fig 2C), scRNA cl1/cl20 (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Not the same gene as Demesa-Arevalo 2026 HvSCR2 (5HG0463700). The paper's 'consistent with Kirschner 2017 in situ' could not be confirmed: Kirschner et al. 2017 Front Plant Sci (PMC5519606) has only a Histone H4 in situ. Not raised.

[outer cortex] Subtilisin-chymotrypsin inhibitor-2A-like (UniProt A0A8I6W3S9, 74 aa); HCR in outer cortex only, absent from inner cortex (Fig 2B) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Function unrelated to cortex identity. Use to split outer vs inner cortex.
Lipid-transfer-protein-like (UniProt A0A8I6XEF9, 111 aa); HCR in cortex per text (Suppl Fig 2B, image not seen) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv).

AMP1-like glutamate carboxypeptidase; Molecular Cartography in cortex per text (Suppl Fig 2A, not seen) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). ID not printed in Dolata; taken from Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants Supp Table 5 (same MC probeset). REVIEW: confirm ID against Dolata Suppl.

Class III HD-ZIP TF (UniProt A0A8I6YL72, 867 aa; Mercator HD-ZIP III); Molecular Cartography cross-section in central stele (Fig 2E), scRNA cl5/cl10 (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). HD-ZIP III specify provascular/metaxylem identity in Arabidopsis; single barley study.
TCP-domain TF (UniProt A0A8I6YTG5, 400 aa); Molecular Cartography in stele files above the QC (Fig 2D), scRNA cl5/cl10 (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv).

SHORTROOT ortholog per paper (UniProt A0A8I6WZ85, 597 aa, uncharacterized GRAS-size); scRNA feature plot (Suppl Fig 2I) and pseudotime (Fig 4B') only; also in QC/Niche cl2 (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Cited barley in situ (Kirschner 2017) not found in PMC5519606.

LOB-domain RAMOSA2 ortholog; Molecular Cartography in stele per text (Suppl Fig 2C, not seen) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). ID from Demesa-Arevalo 2026 tables, not printed in Dolata. Spikelet-meristem gene in barley_shoot_apex, so root-only use.

GNAT N-acetyltransferase; Molecular Cartography in vasculature per text (Suppl Fig 2G, not seen) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). ID from Demesa-Arevalo 2026 tables. In the shoot apex it marks ground/pith tissue, not vasculature (barley_shoot_apex draft).

Papain-like cysteine protease (UniProt A0A8I6YF71/B4ESE6, 356 aa; Mercator RD21/XCP, vessel PCD); text assigns xylem cl23 'based on expression of' this gene (Suppl Fig 2E, not seen; scRNA or MC unclear) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Lowered from the review's medium: in situ not confirmed. Proto- vs metaxylem not stated.
VND7 ortholog per paper (UniProt M0YAC7, NAC domain, 319 aa, no VND name); vessel-differentiation master TF in Arabidopsis; scRNA and pseudotime only (Fig 4B'') (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv).

MYB-CC TF (UniProt A0A8I6YRX3, 348 aa) called HvAPL; scRNA and pseudotime only (Fig 4B''') (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Conflict: Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants call paralog 6HG0570890 HvAPL; which paralog is the true APL ortholog is unresolved, so low.

REVIEW: [columella stem cells, cl21] HCR in CSC but also metaxylem and phloem (Fig 2A), so not specific; UniProt A0A8I6YA77 is a 160 aa Bet v I/MLP protein, contradicting the paper's kinase annotation (ID typo or annotation error) (Dolata et al. 2026 bioRxiv).
